# Stash Client Operations

*Navigation: [[index|← StashStats Index]] / [[client-overview|Client Architecture]] / Stash Client Operations*
*Siblings: [[client-yarn|Yarn Operations]] · [[client-projects|Project Operations]]*

The `StashClientMixin` provides synchronous endpoints for searching public stash items and querying authenticated personal inventories.

## Public Stash Search

`search_stash` queries Ravelry's global stash catalog with filtering and sort parameters:

```{.python include="../src/stashstats/client/stash.py" snippet="stash-search"}
```

## User Stash Retrieval

`get_stash_list` fetches paginated inventory entries for a specific username:

```{.python include="../src/stashstats/client/stash.py" snippet="stash-get-list"}
```
